# CV

Julius Niemeyer — b. 1992, Munich · Lives and works in Munich

## Education

2018–25 Fine Arts (Sculpture, Painting, Graphics, Sound), Academy of Fine Arts Munich — Diploma / Graduation 2025. With Olaf Metzel, Julius von Bismarck, Gerry Bibby, Jan St. Werner and Peter Kogler
2011–17 Diploma in Architecture

## Professional & Organizational

2026– Managing Director, Kunst und Bauen GmbH (BBK)
2026– Board Member, PIN — Friends of the Pinakothek der Moderne, Munich
2025– Board / Co-direction, Rosa Stern Space e.V. and its exhibition project Nebyula
2024– Director, PIN.yc (u40 Friends of the Pinakothek der Moderne / Brandhorst)
2024–26 Head of Office for Art in Architecture, BBK OBB
2024– Member, Commission for Art in Architecture, BBK OBB
2011–24 Team Lead, Site Management, architecture offices (construction volumes up to €20 m)

## Awards & Nominations

2025 Shortlist Nomination, Bavarian Art Promotion Prize (Bayerischer Kunstförderpreis)
2025 ICONIC Award: Innovative Architecture — "Einprozent"
2025 Winner (realization), "kyklos" — Art in Architecture, Isarbalkone Munich (in realization)
2025 Special Mention, "Zuneigung" — Art in Architecture
2024 Winner (realization), "closed system" — Art in Architecture, Landesgartenschau Kirchheim
2024 2nd Prize, "Aktionsraum" — Art in Architecture, TH Darmstadt
